g.text: OXPHOS and complex I are BH-significant; ROS is contextual
U1-U2: upstream context; D1-D3: minimum downstream steps
D3 paths to all 15 observed query hits
All model edges among displayed nodes are retained
Display threshold >=1/6 is a coverage choice, not a significance cutoff
Thick black border: mitochondrial query hit at >=1/6
Node size and x/6 show neighborhood recurrence
U1-U2 nodes are upstream context; D1-D3 nodes lie downstream; arrows follow the Bayesian-network direction
